title: He's Out. Or Is He?
subject: Jensen Huang
role: Founder, resigned as Nvidia CEO on Nov 12, 2026
parody: Parody game. The situation is real and linked below; every statement, headline and reaction in the game is invented. Not affiliated with or endorsed by anyone depicted.

setup.headline: He's out. Or is he?
setup.dek: Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation on Thursday, days after opening an investigation into reports he was the target of a foreign intelligence effort. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Two big investors now want him back. Five real questions. Twenty seconds each. Pick his answer.

context: Real situation, mid-November 2026: Nov 8 the Nvidia board opened an independent investigation into reports Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort (a contact linked to Megaspeed, a Singapore firm that bought billions in Nvidia gear and is probed over export controls). The FBI is looking into it. Nov 12 he resigned as CEO and director; CFO Colette Kress became interim CEO and Harvey Jones the first board chair. Nvidia lost over $600B in market value that week. Nov 14 two major investors urged the board to consider his return. House committee chairs want him at a closed-door briefing on Nov 18; his trip to APEC in Shenzhen is in doubt. Keep everything non-sexual.

rounds.question: Did you resign, or were you pushed?
rounds.source: The board accepted his resignation on Nov 12, hours after reports it was preparing to remove him.

options.text: I've stepped down. I have nothing further to add.
The board and I agreed it was the right call for Nvidia, and I respect it.
Pushed? Nobody pushes me. I walked out, and I took the jacket.
At a $4 trillion company, resigned and pushed are the same verb.
I was not pushed. I was rendered. In 4K. With ray tracing.

rounds.question: The President says you told him you had no idea your contact was an alleged spy. True?
rounds.source: On Nov 9 the President said the FBI was looking into it and that Huang told him he had no idea.

options.text: That's a matter for the investigation. I'm cooperating fully.
I told the President the truth, and I'll tell investigators the same.
If I'd known, do you think I'd still be taking your calls?
In Silicon Valley everyone's a spy. We just call it networking.
I can't detect spies. I can only detect frame drops.

rounds.question: Three House committee chairs want you at a closed-door briefing on Nov 18, or a subpoena. Will you go?
rounds.source: Three House Republican committee chairs asked him to attend a closed-door briefing on Nov 18.

options.text: My lawyers are reviewing the request.
I'll be there on the 18th and answer every question I can.
Congress wants a briefing? I'll bring slides. They'll love the slides.
Do they want a briefing, or to finally learn what a GPU is?
I'll attend as a hologram, rendered live on 72 H200s.

rounds.question: Nvidia lost $600 billion in a week. What do you tell us?
rounds.source: Nvidia lost more than $600 billion in market value in the week of Nov 9.

options.text: Our fundamentals are unchanged. Demand remains strong.
I'm sorry for the turbulence. The team that built this is still here.
We lost $600 billion in a week. We'll make it back by Christmas. Watch.
Relax. It's only one Apple. We have more.
Think of it as a discount. Buy the dip. Buy my jacket. Buy everything.

rounds.question: We asked the board to consider your return. What is your pitch?
rounds.source: On Nov 14 two major investors urged the board to consider the potential return of Jensen Huang.

options.text: That's the board's decision.
I'd only come back if the board, the investigation and the staff all agree.
I started this company in a Denny's booth. Give me the keys and a booth.
Take me back, or enjoy explaining CUDA to the next CEO.
Reinstate me and I will hand-deliver every GPU. By scooter.

awful: Chinese government is looking for you
Washington is also looking for you
Legal asks everyone to stop talking

endings.headline: THE COMEBACK.
endings.dek: The board takes him back. The jacket returns to the keynote.

endings.headline: BACK BY CHRISTMAS?
endings.dek: Investors are sold. The board wants one more week.

endings.headline: FOUNDER EMERITUS.
endings.dek: A nice title, a nice office, no keys.

endings.headline: STILL OUT.
endings.dek: The board thanks him for his contributions. Again.

endings.headline: SUBPOENAED.
endings.dek: Legal has asked everyone to stop typing.
